title: China Just Opened the World's Highest Bridge #shorts
description:
The Huajiang Grand Canyon Bridge in Guizhou opened on 28 Sept 2025: its deck sits 625 m above the river, the highest of any bridge on Earth.

New China Short every day; full reality-show recap every Saturday. Subscribe to @mainlandunpacked.

Sources: Smithsonian Magazine; The Structural Engineer. Footage: China News Service (CC BY).

scenes.text: China just opened the highest bridge on Earth.
headline: WORLD'S
HIGHEST BRIDGE

scenes.text: The Huajiang Grand Canyon Bridge in Guizhou sits 625 meters above the river below.
scenes.label: from the deck down to the river

scenes.text: That's almost twice the height of the Eiffel Tower, and 60 meters above the old record holder, also in Guizhou.
Crossing this canyon used to take up to two hours on winding mountain roads. Now it takes about two minutes.
Guizhou is so mountainous, it has nearly half of the world's hundred highest bridges.
scenes.label: Beipanjiang Bridge, 565 m

scenes.text: Would you drive across it? Tell me in the comments.
